stem: A blind employee must read sensitive information during a quiet public meeting without disturbing attendees. Which assistive technology setup best meets this requirement?

options.text: A screen magnifier that enlarges text and increases contrast.
options.rationale: Screen magnification requires sufficient residual vision to read enlarged text.

options.text: A screen reader connected to a refreshable braille display.
options.rationale: A refreshable braille display enables silent, tactile reading of digital information translated by a screen reader.

options.text: A desktop text-to-speech engine reading the document through the computer's speakers.
options.rationale: Audio output through system speakers would disrupt the meeting and compromise confidentiality.

options.text: An optical character recognition scanner that converts the printed page into a digital text file.
options.rationale: An OCR scanner turns a page image into text, but without a screen reader or braille display it does not present the content to the user.

explanation: A refreshable braille display converts digital text sent from a screen reader into raised braille cells dynamically. This provides individuals who are blind or deaf-blind with a tactile reading option that can be operated silently in meetings or public spaces.
